rows.grounds: indeclinable numeral adverb; indicates threefold repetition of the action
from kaṭī (waist, hip); denotes the location where wrapping is performed
optative form of √veṣṭ (to wrap, encircle); expresses prescribed action
compound of bhāryā (wife), garbha (womb, embryo), rakṣā (protection), and kara (making, effecting); qualifies the wrapping as effecting protection of the wife's womb
adjective para (supreme, highest); emphasizes the excellence of the protective measure
